The '''fourth moon''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gelemeade]] was an inhospitable environment. However, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a routine scan of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] detected signs of simple organic life beneath its uninhabitable surface, and further investigation found a variety of exotic life underground.<ref name="Mission" />

==Behind the scenes==
The fourth moon of Gelemeade was first mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in the Bioanalysis crew skill mission "Signs of Life".<ref name="Mission" />
